Bug_Title: Min and max used in combination should not always return the same value
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the doRangeCheck method. The Math.min function is used with LOWER and num, and then the Math.max function is used with UPPER and the result from the previous step. This can result in the same value being returned even if num is within the range defined by LOWER and UPPER.
Trigger_Explanation: The bug is triggered when a number outside the defined range is passed to the showBug method. The test expects the method to return the upper bound of the range, but it will actually return a value that is out of the range.
